programs.title: NO
programs.desc: Animal tamer OJ Haywood (Daniel Kaluuya) and his sister Emerald (Keke Palmer) live on a ranch in southern California where horses are trained for Hollywood film productions.They take over the business of their father, who died in suspicious circumstances.Problems are piling up for them.One day they become witnesses of inexplicable phenomena.Together with a former child star (Steven Yeun), an emcee at a family amusement park, they try to film supernatural incidents to make money by selling sensational materials.Their actions have unforeseen consequences.Director Jordan Peele made his debut in 2017 with the acclaimed thriller "Get Out!", for which he won an Oscar for the script.

programs.title: Man on Fire
programs.desc: American John Creasy (Denzel Washington) is a man haunted by nightmares from his past.He is a former assassin who worked for the CIA for many years.Frustrated, he avoids people and seeks solace in alcohol.Creasy comes to Mexico to visit his old friend and colleague, Rayburn (Christopher Walken).The city is currently gripped by a wave of kidnappings for ransom.Rich residents panic and many of them hire security guards to ensure the safety of their children.A friend finds John a job as a bodyguard for ten-year-old Pita Ramos (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of Mexican industrialist Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony) and his American wife Lisa (Radha Mitchell).At first, Creasy has a hard time coping with the girl's presence.Over time, however, he becomes friends with her.Under its influence, he changes his attitude to life and gives up alcohol.Soon, however, little Pita is kidnapped.The desperate man does everything to save her.

programs.title: Neighbors 2: Sorority Rising
programs.desc: Mac (Seth Rogen) and Kelly (Rose Byrne) Radner have decided to sell their house and move to a better neighborhood.They are thirty trial days away from finalizing the contract, during which time potential buyers can conduct an inspection and, if they don't like anything, break the contract.It's bad luck that students from the Kappa Nu sorority show up in the area.Shelby (Chloë Grace Moretz), Beth (Kiersey Clemons) and Nora (Beanie Feldstein) - just like their predecessors - love to throw parties.The Radners must enlist the help of their old enemy, Teddy Sanders (Zac Efron).The recent college star is struggling with his own issues.Lonely, he wants to be needed by someone at all costs.

programs.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programs.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.

programs.title: Focus
programs.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programs.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programs.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.
